scripts.build:wasm: cd .. && wasm-pack build crate --out-dir pkg-web --target web --no-pack && mkdir -p demo-line/public/wasm && cp crate/pkg-web/plat_observe.js crate/pkg-web/plat_observe_bg.wasm demo-line/public/wasm/
scripts.dev: bun run build:wasm && bunx wrangler dev worker.ts --port 3337
scripts.deploy: bun run build:wasm && bunx wrangler deploy --env production
scripts.secret:token: bunx wrangler secret put CHANNEL_ACCESS_TOKEN --env production
scripts.secret:secret: bunx wrangler secret put CHANNEL_SECRET --env production
